title: Credit Card Billing Complaints Jump 80% in 2026: Know Your Rights
discussion_signal: The post relays a claimed increase in CFPB credit-card billing complaints and frames complaint filing as a consumer-rights and debt-relief route. It is a commercial interpretation of public data, not an independent estimate of the API slice or evidence that complaint escalation produces relief.
linked_research_question: How are changes in administrative complaint volume translated into consumer-rights expectations, and when do those expectations become verified correction or relief?
limits: The post's 80% claim is not the same denominator or period as the retained API slice
Commercial framing can overstate likely debt-relief outcomes
No account-level correction, payment, or later outcome is documented
